guard_correction.change: Remove absolute unit floor from residual-degeneracy tolerance; retain only within-group response and fitted-slope scale.
guard_correction.branch_invariance_argument: The corrected threshold is never larger than the old threshold. All 30000 R campaign attempts passed the old guard: 29259 accepted; 741 reached the later lme4 optimizer code-3 check. Therefore all pass the corrected guard as well. This is a control-flow argument, not a new fit or cross-version validation.

limits: The reliability map retains the original frozen campaign results. The guard correction has local regression/package evidence, not a new campaign.
